questions.question: How many days do I have to return an item?
questions.answer: Most items can be returned within 45 days of the delivery date, or 60 days if you are a Larkspur Club member.

questions.question: What is the return window for Larkspur Club members?
questions.answer: Larkspur Club members have a 60-day return window.

questions.question: Can I return hiking boots that I already wore on a trail?
questions.answer: No, you cannot return hiking boots that have been worn outdoors unless they are defective.

questions.question: Which items are final sale and cannot be returned?
questions.answer: The following items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged: clearance items marked 'Final Sale' on the product page or price tag, gift cards and e-gift cards, custom-embroidered or personalized items, opened fuel canisters and opened bear spray.

questions.question: How long does it take to process my refund after the warehouse inspects my return?
questions.answer: Refunds are processed within 5 business days after the returned item is inspected at our Boise warehouse.

questions.question: How are returns without a receipt refunded?
questions.answer: Returns without a receipt receive store credit for the lowest selling price of the item in the last 90 days.

questions.question: If I received an item as a gift, who gets the refund when I return it?
questions.answer: The gift recipient receives the refund as store credit.

questions.question: Does it cost anything to return an online order to a Larkspur store?
questions.answer: Returning an online order to any Larkspur store is always free.

questions.question: Do exchanges for a different size cost anything to ship?
questions.answer: Exchanges for a different size or color of the same item ship free of charge.

questions.question: How long after ordering can I still change my shipping address?
questions.answer: You can change your shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order by contacting customer care.

questions.question: Does Larkspur ship to Mexico?
questions.answer: I couldn't find this in the documents you have access to, so I can't answer it reliably.

questions.question: Can bear spray be shipped to Hawaii?
questions.answer: No, according to [S1], fuel canisters and bear spray cannot be shipped to Alaska, Hawaii or Canada.

questions.question: How do I report an item that arrived damaged?
questions.answer: Report damaged items within 7 days of delivery with photos of the item and the box.

questions.question: How many points do I earn per dollar on Larkspur-brand items?
questions.answer: You earn 2 points for every $1 spent on Larkspur-brand items.

questions.question: Do I earn loyalty points when I buy a gift card?
questions.answer: No, you do not earn loyalty points on gift card purchases.

questions.question: When do points from an order show up in my account?
questions.answer: Points from an order are added to the account 14 days after the order ships.

questions.question: How much do I need to spend to reach the Summit tier?
questions.answer: You need to spend $1,000 in a calendar year to reach the Summit tier.

questions.question: What benefits does the Summit tier include?
questions.answer: The Summit tier includes free expedited shipping on every order, a 15% birthday discount on one order during the birthday month, and early access to seasonal sales.

questions.question: What happens to my points if I close my Larkspur Club account?
questions.answer: Unused points and rewards are forfeited when an account is closed and cannot be transferred to another member.

questions.question: What are the Sunday hours of the Salt Lake City store?
questions.answer: The Salt Lake City store is open from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Sundays.

questions.question: Which Larkspur stores offer gear rentals?
questions.answer: The Boise and Bend stores offer gear rentals.

questions.question: How long is an online pickup order held at the store?
questions.answer: Online orders marked 'pickup' are usually ready within 2 hours during store opening hours, and orders are held at the store for 7 days; after that they are cancelled and refunded.

questions.question: What do I need to bring to collect an in-store pickup order?
questions.answer: You need to bring the order confirmation and a photo ID.

questions.question: Are Larkspur stores open on Thanksgiving?
questions.answer: Yes, according to [S1], all stores are closed on Thanksgiving Day.

questions.question: What does the Trail Promise cover?
questions.answer: The Trail Promise covers defects in materials and workmanship, but not normal wear and tear, accidents, damage from improper care or storage, alterations, or damage caused by animals.

questions.question: What does "lifetime" mean in the Trail Promise?
questions.answer: The functional life of the product, not the life of the owner.

questions.question: How long are Larkspur-brand headlamps covered by the warranty?
questions.answer: Larkspur-brand electronics, such as headlamps, are covered for 2 years from the purchase date instead of a lifetime.

questions.question: Does Larkspur help with warranty claims for products from other brands?
questions.answer: Yes, according to [S1], Larkspur helps customers file claims during the first 12 months after purchase.

questions.question: What do I need to include when I file a warranty claim?
questions.answer: You need to include the order number (or the store receipt) and clear photos of the problem.

questions.question: Where are warranty repairs done?
questions.answer: The Larkspur Repair Center in Ogden, Utah.

questions.question: How long do warranty repairs usually take?
questions.answer: Repair turnaround is usually 3 to 4 weeks, plus shipping time.

questions.question: Who pays the shipping for an approved warranty repair?
questions.answer: Larkspur pays shipping both ways for approved warranty repairs.

questions.question: How long is a quote for a paid repair valid?
questions.answer: A quote for a paid repair is valid for 30 days.

questions.question: How should I wash a down sleeping bag?
questions.answer: You should wash a down sleeping bag in a front-loading machine on a gentle cold cycle with a down-specific soap. Never use a top-loading machine with an agitator.

questions.question: How should I store a down sleeping bag?
questions.answer: Store the bag uncompressed in its large cotton storage sack, not in the stuff sack.

questions.question: Can I put my tent in the washing machine?
questions.answer: No, according to the Product Care Guide, you should never machine wash a tent.

questions.question: How often should I re-apply seam sealer to my tent?
questions.answer: You should re-apply seam sealer every 2 years or when seams start to leak.

questions.question: How do I restore the water-repellent finish on a waterproof jacket?
questions.answer: To restore the water-repellent finish, tumble dry the jacket on medium heat for 20 minutes after washing.

questions.question: How far from a campfire should I keep wet boots while they dry?
questions.answer: At least 2 feet (60 cm) away from fires, stoves and heaters.

questions.question: What should I do with trekking poles after a wet hike?
questions.answer: Take the pole sections apart and let them dry separately so the locking mechanisms do not corrode.

questions.question: What are the core hours for office-based employees?
questions.answer: The standard core hours for office-based employees are from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Mountain Time, Monday to Friday.

questions.question: How many days per week can office employees work remotely?
questions.answer: Office-based employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with their manager's approval.

questions.question: Can warehouse staff work remotely?
questions.answer: No, according to [S1], retail and warehouse roles are not eligible for remote work.

questions.question: How many PTO days does a full-time employee get in their first year?
questions.answer: A full-time employee receives 18 days of paid time off (PTO) per year during their first 3 years of employment.

questions.question: How many unused PTO days can be carried over into the next year?
questions.answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days can be carried over into the next calendar year.

questions.question: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
questions.answer: A doctor's note is only required for absences longer than 3 consecutive working days.

questions.question: How much paid parental leave do primary caregivers get?
questions.answer: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

questions.question: What is the employee discount on other brands?
questions.answer: Employees receive a 20% discount on other brands.

questions.question: How long can I borrow demo gear from the gear library?
questions.answer: Employees can borrow demo gear from the gear library for up to 14 days at a time.

questions.question: How many paid volunteer days do employees get each year?
questions.answer: Every employee receives 2 paid volunteer days per year to support conservation and community organizations.

questions.question: When are performance reviews held?
questions.answer: Performance reviews take place twice a year, in March and September.

questions.question: Within how many days must I submit an expense report?
questions.answer: You must submit an expense report within 30 days of the expense.

questions.question: Above what amount are receipts required for expenses?
questions.answer: Receipts are required for every expense over $25.

questions.question: Who has to approve a business trip that will cost about $4,000?
questions.answer: A vice president needs to approve a business trip that will cost about $4,000.

questions.question: Can I book business class for a 9-hour flight?
questions.answer: No, according to [S1], business class is not reimbursed.

questions.question: What is the nightly hotel limit in Seattle?
questions.answer: The nightly lodging limit in high-cost cities, including Seattle, is $275 per night.

questions.question: What is the meal per diem for international travel?
questions.answer: The meal per diem for international travel is $85 per day.

questions.question: Is alcohol reimbursable on business trips?
questions.answer: No, according to [S3], alcohol is never reimbursable.

questions.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for a personal car?
questions.answer: Employees who use a personal car for business are reimbursed $0.67 per mile.

questions.question: Above what amount must I use the corporate card for a travel purchase?
questions.answer: You must use the corporate card for any single travel purchase over $500.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

questions.question: What second factor do finance staff have to use?
questions.answer: Finance staff must use a hardware security key as their second factor.

questions.question: How quickly do I have to report a lost work laptop?
questions.answer: You must report a lost work laptop to the security team within 1 hour of noticing.

questions.question: What is the extension of the IT help line?
questions.answer: The extension of the IT help line is 4357.

questions.question: What should I do with a suspicious email?
questions.answer: Do not forward suspicious emails to colleagues and do not click links or open attachments in them.

questions.question: After how many minutes of inactivity do laptop screens lock?
questions.answer: Laptop screens lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.

questions.question: Can I use a USB stick on my company laptop?
questions.answer: No, according to Source S1, USB storage devices are blocked on all company laptops.

questions.question: Where may customer payment card data be stored or processed?
questions.answer: Customer payment card data must never be stored in shared drives, email or chat, and may only be processed in the payment system.

questions.question: By when must the annual security training be completed?
questions.answer: All employees complete security awareness training every year by January 31.

questions.question: Is a Larkspur-brand GPS unit covered for life, and can I buy Summit Care for it?
questions.answer: No, according to [S2], electronics are covered for 2 years from the purchase date instead of a lifetime. Additionally, [S1] states that Summit Care is not available for electronics.

questions.question: Is standard shipping free for a $60 order placed on December 5, 2026, and would the same order ship free in February 2027?
questions.answer: Yes, standard shipping is free for orders of $50 or more within the contiguous United States. The holiday period applies from November 20, 2026 to December 31, 2026, so it would be free on December 5, 2026. However, after December 31, 2026, the regular shipping policy applies again, and standard shipping is only free on orders of $75 or more.

questions.question: How much does expedited shipping normally cost, and what does a Summit tier member pay for it?
questions.answer: Expedited shipping normally costs $14.95 [S2]. A Summit tier member pays the same amount as any other customer, because there is no mention of free or discounted expedited shipping for Summit tier members in the sources.

questions.question: How should I dry wet hiking boots, and is damage from drying them next to a heater covered by the warranty?
questions.answer: To dry wet hiking boots, keep them at least 2 feet (60 cm) away from fires, stoves, and heaters because direct heat cracks leather and weakens glue. Damage caused by improper care is not covered by the warranty.

questions.question: I'm an employee buying a Larkspur-brand tent. What employee discount do I get, and how many loyalty points per dollar would that item earn?
questions.answer: As an employee, you receive a 40% discount on Larkspur-brand items [S1]. Therefore, the price of the Larkspur-brand tent will be discounted by 40%. Additionally, since it's a Larkspur-brand item, you'll earn 2 points for every $1 spent on it [S2].

questions.question: A work laptop was stolen while an employee was working remotely. Which security rule applies to remote work, and how fast must the theft be reported?
questions.answer: The Information Security Policy applies to remote work. The employee must report the lost or stolen device within 1 hour of noticing.

questions.question: Which hazardous items can't be shipped to Canada, and can they be returned once opened?
